                    greeting, example_dialogue, voice_anchor, appearance_tags, default_tone,
                    default_reply_style, default_reply_custom, age, is_adult, extensions_json,
                    created_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
             RETURNING id AS "id!"
